einzeiler: An aging colonist on Titan investigates the mysterious disappearance of her fellow…
kurzfassung: Decades after losing contact with Earth, the remaining colonists on Titan begin vanishing inside a terraformed cave system. As Daisy searches for her missing crewmates, she confronts a strange, fast-spreading native mold and blurring lines between reality and memory. The story explores isolation, human connection, and the weight of what is left behind.
stichpunkte: Daisy and Cooper are the last two surviving colonists at the Titan settlement after decades of isolation from Earth.
Colleagues enter a terraformed cave system to investigate anomalies and subsequently stop responding.
Cooper enters the caves to search for missing crew members, despite Daisy's warnings about safety protocols.
A fungus-like native organism is discovered spreading rapidly throughout the subterranean habitats and interacting with terraformed cells.
Daisy enters the cave herself and finds her colleagues incapacitated or dead, covered in thick layers of black mold.
Vivid memories of Earth and an idealized partner named Emmett intertwine with Daisy's failing grip on reality as the infection takes hold.

clips.hook: Living on Titan twice as long as Earth
clips.text: The protagonist reflects on her long tenure on Saturn's moon while still considering her home planet to be the place where her roots lie.

clips.hook: Traps serving as predators in a terraformed cave
clips.text: Mechanical devices take the place of natural hunters to control insect populations inside the engineered subterranean environment.

clips.hook: Titan claimed more than half the colonists
clips.text: Over three decades of settlement, the harsh environment steadily reduced the small population of pioneers.

clips.hook: Knowing a place so well you can visit it in dreams
clips.text: The narrator describes the haunting ability to mentally walk through a childhood home that no longer exists.

clips.hook: Meeting on a train platform during a storm
clips.text: A companion describes an alternative memory of their first encounter under rainy skies before a long journey.

beschreibung:
First Publication: Cosmic Horror Monthly February 2005
Performed by Nikolle Doolin

Daisy, a member of an aging colony on Titan, investigates the disappearances of the other colonists.

Sam W. Pisciotta is a writer and visual artist. Find his short fiction in Tales to Terrify, Lightspeed, Asimov’s, Nightmare, PodCastle, and other publications. He is a graduate of the Odyssey writing program (2023) and a member of Clarion’s 2026 Novel Writing Workshop. Sam has an M.A. in Literary Studies from the University of Colorado. Powered on morning coffee and late-night tea, he splits his time between Colorado and New York. Connect at www.silo34.com and @silo34 on Instagram, and @swpisciotta on BlueSky Social.
